title: Power Query Can Keep the WRONG Duplicate 😳 #excel #powerquery #shorts
description: Sorting newest-first before Remove Duplicates can still keep an unexpected row in Power Query. Microsoft documents that Table.Distinct does not guarantee which duplicate is preserved because query folding/optimization can change evaluation. This realistic walkthrough shows a deterministic keep-first pattern using Table.Buffer before Table.Distinct. #excel #powerquery #datacleaning
visual_style: realistic Power Query screen demo with cursor actions and verification
research_signal: Microsoft Learn explicitly warns that Table.Distinct does not guarantee which duplicate is preserved and recommends Table.Buffer for predictable duplicate removal.

captions.text: Power Query can keep the wrong duplicate.
Newest row is sorted to the top.
Then Remove Duplicates keeps an older row.
Table.Distinct does not guarantee which duplicate survives.
Buffer the sorted table before Distinct.
Table.Buffer → then Table.Distinct on Customer ID.
Now verify the latest date remains.
Sort shows order. Buffer makes it deterministic.
